task: At every moment the ball is out of the way of the door, you have to be carrying the key then, or pick it up later.

calls.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: The task 'At every moment the ball is out of the way of the door, you have to be carrying the key then, or pick it up later' states a rule, not a goal: if blocker_moved ever happens, has_door_key must also happen, either by already carrying it at that moment or by picking it up later — that is exactly the hard RespondedExistence(blocker_moved, has_door_key). The 'carrying the key then, or pick it up later' disjunction allows has_door_key before, with, or after blocker_moved, so RespondedExistence (not Response) is the right template. The task requires nothing unconditionally (no 'pick up the box' goal), so the empty FINAL_STATES with the rule-only warning is valid.
